commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Guillermo Cuadra has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+3' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Paulo Gazzaniga is alert and denies him with a nice save.
90+2' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Vinicius Junior will be replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
90' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
87' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

87' Bryan Gil (Girona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luka Modric leaves the pitch and Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) comes on.
85' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' 2 - 0 Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
80' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
80' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga reacts superbly to deny him.
79' Daley Blind (Girona) is penalised for holding. Guillermo Cuadra signals a set piece.
75' It is time for a substitution. Bojan Miovski (Girona) is on for Miguel Gutierrez.
75' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly over the bar. The goalkeeper was lucky!
73' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. David Alaba is replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
73' Here's the change. Brahim Diaz leaves the pitch and Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
72' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just over the bar.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a chip pass into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga is quickest to intercept the ball.
66' Substitution. Yaser Asprilla (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Arnaut Danjuma walks off.
66' Michel has decided to substitute Oriol Romeu and he is replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
66' Ivan Martin comes off the pitch to be replaced by Bryan Gil (Girona).

66' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
65' It seemed like Luka Modric (Real Madrid) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
64' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Ladislav Krejci (Girona) for his blatant foul.
64' Ivan Martin (Girona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
63' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

63' A pass lands at the feet of Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Madrid.
59' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
58' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donny van de Beek departs the field of play to be replaced by Arthur Melo (Girona).
56' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.

55' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
54' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

52' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
52' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

52' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
51' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
51' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes it short.
51' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
49' Half-chance! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) plays a pass into the box, but Thibaut Courtois reacts well to snuff out the attack.
48' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
48' The attendance for today's match is 74028.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Guillermo Cuadra has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) brings his opponent down. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid win a corner kick.

41' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Luka Modric (Real Madrid) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Paulo Gazzaniga, so the score changes to 1:0.
41' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
39' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
39' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
34' A short pass finds Rodrygo (Real Madrid). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
34' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

33' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.
32' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
30' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared.

30' Donny van de Beek (Girona) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Thibaut Courtois is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
28' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is cleared.
28' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The referee blows his whistle, Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
27' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
25' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
22' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
20' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
20' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
17' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) whips in a cross from the corner, but Thibaut Courtois is well positioned and punches the ball away.
17' The ball breaks to Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.
15' A decent cross gives Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
15' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
10' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Kylian Mbappe. The ball has crossed the sideline. Girona are taking a throw-in.
7' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
6' The corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.
6' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Paulo Gazzaniga is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.
5' A lofted cross from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Girona win a corner.
4' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
2' Daley Blind (Girona) makes a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Girona will kick the game off.
